observations: Wall-mounted hair dryer, white body with gray accents, mounted on a wall bracket.
Brand text 'MAAT BATHROOMS' printed in blue on the body, visible in photo 0, photo 1, and photo 2.
Coiled white cord with a plug visible hanging below the unit in all three photos.
No power cable rating label, wattage sticker, or model number legible in any photo.
Unit is shown only mounted on the wall; it is not shown powered on or in use.
Wall surface behind the unit shows visible staining/mold, suggesting a bathroom installation site, not necessarily the seller's own use context.
Watermarks 'POSTED ON JIJI / GOOD-ERA' overlay all three images, consistent with a resale listing site.

claims.evidence: No performance, airflow, or heat test shown in any photo; 'quality' is a subjective claim with no demonstrable photo evidence.

risks.risk: Unit may not power on or heat/blow air correctly.
risks.proof: A short video clip of the dryer plugged in, switched on, showing airflow and warm air.

risks.risk: Electrical rating (voltage/wattage) unknown, affecting compatibility and value.
risks.proof: Close-up photo of the rating label/sticker, usually on the underside or near the plug.
risks.if_unproven: priced as unknown spec, base-tier assumption

risks.risk: Wall bracket may or may not be included in the sale (unit is shown pre-installed).
risks.proof: Photo of the dryer and bracket separated, or confirmation that bracket is included.
risks.if_unproven: priced as dryer body only, no bracket

risks.risk: Hidden cosmetic damage (cracks, scuffs) on sides not shown.
risks.proof: Additional photos from top, bottom, and rear angles.
risks.if_unproven: priced assuming visible condition only, no premium for 'like new'

risks.risk: Cord or plug may be damaged/frayed, not clearly visible due to coiling.
risks.proof: Close-up photo of the plug head and full cord length uncoiled.
risks.if_unproven: priced as cord condition unverified, worst case assumed

proof_requests: Video of the dryer plugged in and running, showing airflow and heat.
Close-up photo of the rating/label sticker showing voltage and wattage.
Confirmation and photo showing whether the wall bracket is included.
Photos of the unit from additional angles (top, bottom, rear) to rule out damage.
Close-up of the plug and full cord to check for fraying or damage.
response.reason: The item is clearly identifiable by brand and type as a MAAT wall-mounted hair dryer, but no working demonstration, rating label, or bracket inclusion is shown, so it must be priced at worst case as an untested unit with unknown completeness.
